items.title: Library supplement: Smooth polynomial features in Gaussian L²

source.anchor: F1 in source-only.json; proof topology P1, P2.
source.attribution: Original generic exposition of Gaussian polynomial and finite Hermite features; existing proofs reused without a novelty or primary-textbook completion claim.

items.statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma_E=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\) be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. For every real polynomial \(p\) and every \(w\in E\), the literal function \(x\mapsto p(\langle w,x\rangle)\) belongs to \(L^2(\gamma_E)\). Its equivalence-class map is globally \(C^\infty\) on all of \(E\). The membership witnesses are produced by the proof and used to form these actual classes.
assumptions: The finite-dimensional real inner-product and Borel structures are the actual structures on the same carrier \(E\).
\(\gamma_E\) is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. No positive dimension restriction is imposed.
\(p\) has arbitrary real coefficients and arbitrary finite degree; \(w\) is any ambient vector.
